answers.stem_only: Use AWS WAF at the edge, not Shield Advanced (too costly for a layer 7 flood that WAF handles): associate a WAF web ACL with the CloudFront distribution, add a rate-based rule that blocks source IPs exceeding a request threshold, and add the AWS managed Amazon IP reputation list rule group to block known bot IP addresses. Network ACLs and Network Firewall act inside the VPC behind CloudFront and cannot see the client IPs well or scale for many changing addresses.
